description: This plot illustrates the relative change across different neural network layer groupings for various token and precision configurations compared to a baseline. The x-axis represents categorical layer groupings, labeled sequentially from left to right as Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" and uses a linear scale ranging from -25% to 5%, with tick marks at intervals of 10% (-25%, -15%, -5%, and 5%). Five lines are displayed on the graph. The "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit" is represented by a gray dashed line with no markers, remaining constant at exactly 0% across all layer groupings. The "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit" is shown as a solid yellow line with circular markers; it begins near 0% at Layer1-4, dips slightly to approximately -2% at Layer13-20, and ends slightly above 0% at Layer29-32. The "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit" is depicted by a solid red line with square markers, starting near 0% at Layer1-4, declining to a low of roughly -4% at Layer13-20, and recovering to near 0% by Layer29-32. The "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit" is a solid light blue line with circular markers, beginning at approximately -2% at Layer1-4, dropping to a minimum of about -13% at Layer13-20, and rising back to roughly -1% at Layer29-32. Finally, the "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit" is represented by a solid dark blue line with square markers; it starts at approximately -3% at Layer1-4, experiences a sharp decline to exactly -25% at Layer13-20, and recovers to approximately -3% at Layer29-32.
caption_used: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as the pruning method, are shown. The plot illustrates the relative change across different layer groupings, with the x-axis labeled 'Layer' and the y-axis labeled 'Relative Change'. The gray dashed line represents the baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit, which remains constant at 0% across all layers. The yellow line (LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit) shows a steady trend, with a slight dip to approximately -5% at Layer13-20 before returning to 0%. The red line (LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit) follows a similar pattern, dipping to -10% at Layer13-20 and recovering to 0% by Layer29-32. The light blue line (RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit) starts at -2%, dips to -15% at Layer13-20, and rises back to -2% by Layer29-32. The dark blue line (RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit) begins at -4%, drops sharply to -30% at Layer13-20, and recovers to -5% by Layer29-32. Overall, the LB-Avg methods demonstrate more stability compared to the RULER4k methods, which exhibit sharper declines at intermediate layers.
